I have implemented `EventListener.BatchDurable`, `WriteOptions.CommitCorrelationID`, the DB durability wait/notification/stats methods, and `Metrics.DurableCommitCount` / `Metrics.DurableCommitDuration`, and launched the race-enabled durability test suite. Waiting for the test execution to finish.
I have implemented the batch durability notification and wait APIs on branch `feat/batch-durable` (branched from `main`):

- **`EventListener.BatchDurable` & [`BatchDurableInfo`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-lmki9epu/event.go#L919-L930)**:
  - Added [`BatchDurableInfo`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-lmki9epu/event.go#L919-L930) (`JobID`, `SeqNum`, `Err`, `ApplyDuration`, `SyncDuration`, `CorrelationID`, `BatchSize`, `KeyCount`) and `EventListener.BatchDurable` in [event.go](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-lmki9epu/event.go), wired through [`EventListener.EnsureDefaults`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-lmki9epu/event.go#L1064-L1066), [`MakeLoggingEventListener`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-lmki9epu/event.go#L1162-L1168), and [`TeeEventListener`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-lmki9epu/event.go#L1253-L1265).
  - Added [`WriteOptions.CommitCorrelationID`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-lmki9epu/options.go#L409-L411) in [options.go](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-lmki9epu/options.go).
  - Separated commit apply/publish timing and WAL sync timing in [`commitPipeline.Commit`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-lmki9epu/commit.go#L298-L390), [`commitPipeline.prepare`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-lmki9epu/commit.go#L455-L505), [`Batch.SyncWait`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-lmki9epu/batch.go#L1713-L1728), and [`DB.completeSyncCommit`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-lmki9epu/db.go#L852-L885) so `BatchDurable` fires once per `Sync` commit after the WAL sync completes (including on failure) and never triggers on non-sync commits or when `DisableWAL` is true.
- **DB Durability APIs & [`DurabilityStats`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-lmki9epu/durability.go#L32-L40)**:
  - Implemented [`WaitForDurability`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-lmki9epu/durability.go#L497-L500), [`WaitForDurabilityContext`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-lmki9epu/durability.go#L505-L507), [`WaitForDurabilityBatch`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-lmki9epu/durability.go#L511-L513), [`WaitForDurabilityBatchContext`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-lmki9epu/durability.go#L519-L521), [`WaitForJobDurability`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-lmki9epu/durability.go#L525-L527), [`WaitForJobDurabilityContext`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-lmki9epu/durability.go#L532-L534), [`DurableState`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-lmki9epu/durability.go#L538-L540), [`DurabilityNotify`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-lmki9epu/durability.go#L545-L547), and [`DurabilityStats`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-lmki9epu/durability.go#L550-L552) in [durability.go](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-lmki9epu/durability.go).
- **Metrics**:
  - Added [`Metrics.DurableCommitCount`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-lmki9epu/metrics.go#L384) and [`Metrics.DurableCommitDuration`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-lmki9epu/metrics.go#L387) in [metrics.go](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-lmki9epu/metrics.go) and populated them in [`DB.Metrics`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-lmki9epu/db.go#L2147) when `BatchDurable` is configured.
- **Tests**:
  - Added unit tests in [durability_test.go](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-lmki9epu/durability_test.go).
